Running command: cat > /tmp/fuzz_md4c.py <<'PY'
import os, random, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile, string, time
flags_list=[0xffffffff,0x9ff7f,0x80f00,0x70000,0x100,0x2000,0x1000,0x80000,0x40000,0x20000,0x10000,0]
tokens=[b'',b' ',b'\t',b'\n',b'\r\n',b'[',b']',b'[[',b']]',b'|',b'||',b'!',b'![',b'](',b')',b'(',b'<',b'>',b'</',b'<!--',b'-->',b'<!',b'![CDATA[',b']]>',b'?',b'?>',b'&',b';',b'`',b'``',b'```',b'*',b'**',b'_',b'__',b'~',b'~~',b'^',b'$',b'$$',b'#',b'###',b'-',b'---',b':',b'http://',b'www.',b'@',b'a',b'A',b'0',b'.',b'/',b'=',b'"',b"'",b'> [!NOTE]',b'> [!IMPORTANT]',b'|---|',b'| a | b |']
seeds=[b'\x00'*8+s for s in [b'> [!NOTE]',b'[[a|]]',b'[[|]]',b'||a||',b'^a^',b'~a~',b'$a$',b'|a|\n|-|',b'<a',b'<!',b'<!--',b'[a](',b'[a](<',b'` a\n`']]

def gen():
    if random.random()<0.2:
        s=random.choice(seeds)[8:]
    else:
        n=random.randint(1,80)
        s=b''.join(random.choice(tokens) for _ in range(n))
    # mutations
    if random.random()<0.3:
        s=s.replace(b'a', b'a'*random.randint(50,200),1)
    pf=random.choice(flags_list)
    rf=random.getrandbits(32)
    return struct.pack('<II',pf,rf)+s

start=time.time(); count=0
path='/tmp/cand.bin'
while time.time()-start<120:
    data=gen(); open(path,'wb').write(data)
    r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/run_mdhtml',path],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'abort_on_error=1:detect_leaks=0:symbolize=0'},timeout=2)
    count+=1
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('CRASH',count,'len',len(data),'code',r.returncode)
        print(data)
        print(r.stderr[:2000].decode('latin1','replace'))
        open('/workspace/crash.bin','wb').write(data)
        sys.exit(0)
print('no crash',count)
